figurative_meaning_en: disheveled hair implying a terrifying or demonic appearance
example_sentences_in_bangla: রাতের অন্ধকারে তার এলোকেশ দেখে সবাই ভয় পেয়ে গেল।
গল্পের ভূতনীটি এলোকেশ করে উঠে দাঁড়াল।
example_sentences_in_english: In the darkness of night, her disheveled hair made everyone terrified.
The ghost in the story rose with wild, unkempt hair.
history: References Shyama Sangeet, devotional songs to Goddess Kali depicting her fierce form with disheveled hair.
note: Often used in poetic or devotional contexts to evoke a fearsome divine feminine image.
